target_bug_relation: The protected UI-state test opens the age picker dialog on the add-contact page and then reads the dialog action buttons through the accessibility tree: findComponent(ON.id('add_sure')) and the 'cancel' text, and verifies each resolved component's bounds lie inside the display. On the pre-fix revision (customStyle: true, bottom-aligned custom dialog) the dialog content overflows the bottom of the screen and both action buttons are absent from the accessibility tree, reproducing the reported issue that the cancel key cannot be used because it overlaps the home indicator. On the post-fix revision (customStyle: false) both buttons are present with bounds [324,2503][608,2540] and [609,2503][893,2540] inside the 1216x2688 display. No wall-clock assertions are used.
